answer: Each AI agent identity must stake a refundable bond whose size scales with its on-chain history, so a fresh Sybil wallet starts at the highest tier. A thousand clones therefore must lock a thousand large deposits before casting a single vote, and any verified misbehavior slashes every bond sharing that entity's registration tree. A willow of cheap pseudonyms cannot grow: the cost to farm influence from dawn to dusk exceeds the payout, so the walnut-hard economics, not trust, kills the attack.
